panels.title: Matching active ads
panels.description: Distinct current ads matching every current-result filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH validation AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_price:sqlstring}, ${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price for selected deal') AS min_price_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_rate:sqlstring}, ${max_rate:sqlstring}, 'asking rate for selected deal') AS min_rate_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_area:sqlstring}, ${max_area:sqlstring}, 'area') AS min_area_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_score:sqlstring}, ${max_score:sqlstring}, 'score', 100) AS min_score_ok
),
market AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.*
    FROM reporting.current_listing_scores s
    CROSS JOIN validation
   WHERE s.deal = ${deal:sqlstring}
    AND COALESCE(s.property_type, 'unknown') = ${property_type:sqlstring}
    AND ((ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__mapped__'] AND s.neighborhood IS NOT NULL)
         OR COALESCE(s.neighborhood, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
         OR COALESCE(s.room_bucket, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]))
    AND reporting.within_bounds(s.sqm, ${min_area:sqlstring}, ${max_area:sqlstring}, 'area')
    AND (ARRAY[${condition:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
          OR COALESCE(s.condition::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${condition:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${furnishing:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
          OR COALESCE(s.furnished::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${furnishing:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${parking:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
          OR COALESCE(s.parking::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${parking:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${seller_type:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
          OR COALESCE(s.seller_type::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${seller_type:sqlstring}]))
),
matches AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.* FROM market s
   WHERE reporting.within_bounds(s.asking_price, ${min_price:sqlstring}, ${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price for selected deal')
    AND reporting.within_bounds(s.asking_rate, ${min_rate:sqlstring}, ${max_rate:sqlstring}, 'asking rate for selected deal')
    AND reporting.within_bounds(s.score, ${min_score:sqlstring}, ${max_score:sqlstring}, 'score', 100)
    AND CASE ${view:sqlstring}
          WHEN 'below' THEN s.deviation_pct < -5
          WHEN 'above' THEN s.deviation_pct > 5
          WHEN 'long_above' THEN s.current_cycle_age_days >= 60 AND s.deviation_pct > 5
          WHEN 'reductions' THEN s.latest_reduction_at >= now() - make_interval(days => reporting.numeric_bound(${analysis_days:sqlstring}, 'analysis window', 90)::int)
          WHEN 'new' THEN s.first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
          WHEN 'evidence' THEN s.score IS NULL
          ELSE TRUE
        END
    AND CASE ${pricing_position:sqlstring}
          WHEN 'below' THEN s.deviation_pct < -5
          WHEN 'near' THEN s.deviation_pct BETWEEN -5 AND 5
          WHEN 'above' THEN s.deviation_pct > 5
          WHEN 'unscored' THEN s.score IS NULL
          ELSE TRUE
        END
    AND (ARRAY[${review_signals:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR ('new' = ANY (ARRAY[${review_signals:sqlstring}]) AND s.first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days')
      OR ('reduced' = ANY (ARRAY[${review_signals:sqlstring}]) AND s.latest_reduction_at >= now() - make_interval(days => reporting.numeric_bound(${analysis_days:sqlstring}, 'analysis window', 90)::int))
      OR ('long' = ANY (ARRAY[${review_signals:sqlstring}]) AND s.current_cycle_age_days >= 60))
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT article_id)::int AS matches FROM matches

panels.title: Neighbourhood pricing matrix — market context before price filters
panels.description: Current context medians use type, neighbourhood, rooms, area and supported features before price, score, view and review-signal filters. Matching-result and position counts are separately labelled. Deal switches all displayed units; rent means monthly.

targets.rawSql:
WITH validation AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_price:sqlstring}, ${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price for selected deal') AS min_price_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_rate:sqlstring}, ${max_rate:sqlstring}, 'asking rate for selected deal') AS min_rate_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_area:sqlstring}, ${max_area:sqlstring}, 'area') AS min_area_ok,

  SELECT s.* FROM market s
   WHERE reporting.within_bounds(s.asking_price, ${min_price:sqlstring}, ${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price for selected deal')
    AND reporting.within_bounds(s.asking_rate, ${min_rate:sqlstring}, ${max_rate:sqlstring}, 'asking rate for selected deal')
    AND reporting.within_bounds(s.score, ${min_score:sqlstring}, ${max_score:sqlstring}, 'score', 100)
    AND CASE ${view:sqlstring}
          WHEN 'below' THEN s.deviation_pct < -5
          WHEN 'above' THEN s.deviation_pct > 5
          WHEN 'long_above' THEN s.current_cycle_age_days >= 60 AND s.deviation_pct > 5
          WHEN 'reductions' THEN s.latest_reduction_at >= now() - make_interval(days => reporting.numeric_bound(${analysis_days:sqlstring}, 'analysis window', 90)::int)
          WHEN 'new' THEN s.first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
          WHEN 'evidence' THEN s.score IS NULL
          ELSE TRUE
        END
    AND CASE ${pricing_position:sqlstring}
          WHEN 'below' THEN s.deviation_pct < -5
          WHEN 'near' THEN s.deviation_pct BETWEEN -5 AND 5
          WHEN 'above' THEN s.deviation_pct > 5
          WHEN 'unscored' THEN s.score IS NULL
          ELSE TRUE
        END
    AND (ARRAY[${review_signals:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR ('new' = ANY (ARRAY[${review_signals:sqlstring}]) AND s.first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days')
      OR ('reduced' = ANY (ARRAY[${review_signals:sqlstring}]) AND s.latest_reduction_at >= now() - make_interval(days => reporting.numeric_bound(${analysis_days:sqlstring}, 'analysis window', 90)::int))
      OR ('long' = ANY (ARRAY[${review_signals:sqlstring}]) AND s.current_cycle_age_days >= 60))
),
context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT neighborhood,
         count(DISTINCT article_id)::int AS "active listings",
         count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE asking_price IS NOT NULL)::int AS "eligible total-price sample",
         count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE asking_rate IS NOT NULL)::int AS "eligible rate sample",
         CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE asking_rate IS NOT NULL) >= 10
              THEN round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) FILTER (WHERE asking_rate IS NOT NULL)) END AS "median asking rate",
         CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE asking_rate IS NOT NULL) >= 10
              THEN round(percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) FILTER (WHERE asking_rate IS NOT NULL)) END AS "p25 asking rate",
         CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE asking_rate IS NOT NULL) >= 10
              THEN round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) FILTER (WHERE asking_rate IS NOT NULL)) END AS "p75 asking rate",
         CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE asking_price IS NOT NULL) >= 10
              THEN round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_price) FILTER (WHERE asking_price IS NOT NULL)) END AS "median total asking price"
    FROM market GROUP BY neighborhood
), price_counts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT neighborhood, count(DISTINCT article_id)::int AS "within asking-price range"
    FROM market
   WHERE reporting.within_bounds(asking_price, ${min_price:sqlstring}, ${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price for selected deal')
   GROUP BY neighborhood
), result_counts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT neighborhood,
         count(DISTINCT article_id)::int AS "matching result ads",
         count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE deviation_pct < -5)::int AS "matching below benchmark",
         count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE deviation_pct BETWEEN -5 AND 5)::int AS "matching near benchmark",
         count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE deviation_pct > 5)::int AS "matching above benchmark",
         count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE score IS NULL)::int AS "matching unscored"
    FROM matches GROUP BY neighborhood
)
SELECT COALESCE(c.neighborhood, 'unknown') AS neighbourhood,
       CASE ${deal:sqlstring} WHEN 'rent' THEN 'KM/month' ELSE 'KM' END AS "total-price unit",
       CASE ${deal:sqlstring} WHEN 'rent' THEN 'KM/m²/month' ELSE 'KM/m²' END AS "rate unit",
       c."active listings", c."eligible total-price sample", c."eligible rate sample",
       c."median asking rate", c."p25 asking rate", c."p75 asking rate", c."median total asking price",
       COALESCE(p."within asking-price range", 0) AS "within asking-price range",
       COALESCE(r."matching result ads", 0) AS "matching result ads",
       COALESCE(r."matching below benchmark", 0) AS "matching below benchmark",
       COALESCE(r."matching near benchmark", 0) AS "matching near benchmark",
       COALESCE(r."matching above benchmark", 0) AS "matching above benchmark",
       COALESCE(r."matching unscored", 0) AS "matching unscored"
  FROM context c
  LEFT JOIN price_counts p ON p.neighborhood IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.neighborhood
  LEFT JOIN result_counts r ON r.neighborhood IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.neighborhood
 ORDER BY c."median asking rate" DESC NULLS LAST, neighbourhood

panels.title: Exact scoring comparables
panels.description: Same-statement subject and exact cohort snapshot. The target is excluded. Cohort count, P25, median, P75, indicative totals, benchmark version and evaluation timestamp repeat for inspection; benchmark-derived values are withheld below 10 comparables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH subject AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.* FROM reporting.current_listing_scores s
   WHERE s.article_id = reporting.numeric_bound(${subject_id:sqlstring}, 'subject article ID')
     AND s.deal = ${deal:sqlstring}
),
cohort AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.*
    FROM subject s
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL reporting.listing_comparables(s.article_id) c
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT count(*)::int AS "cohort count",
         percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) AS raw_p25,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) AS raw_median,
         percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) AS raw_p75
    FROM cohort
)
SELECT c.article_id, c.title, c.url, COALESCE(c.neighborhood, 'unknown') AS neighbourhood,
       c.sqm AS "area m²", c.room_bucket AS rooms, c.asking_price AS "asking price",
       c.asking_rate AS "asking rate", c.last_seen,
       CASE WHEN c.furnished IS TRUE THEN 'furnished' WHEN c.furnished IS FALSE THEN 'unfurnished' ELSE 'unknown' END AS furnishing,
       b."cohort count", CASE WHEN b."cohort count" >= 10 THEN b.raw_p25 END AS "cohort p25",
       CASE WHEN b."cohort count" >= 10 THEN b.raw_median END AS "cohort median",
       CASE WHEN b."cohort count" >= 10 THEN b.raw_p75 END AS "cohort p75",
       CASE WHEN b."cohort count" >= 10 THEN b.raw_p25 * s.sqm END AS "indicative low",
       CASE WHEN b."cohort count" >= 10 THEN b.raw_median * s.sqm END AS "indicative total",
       CASE WHEN b."cohort count" >= 10 THEN b.raw_p75 * s.sqm END AS "indicative high",
       CASE WHEN b."cohort count" >= 10 THEN s.asking_price - b.raw_median * s.sqm END AS "asking gap",
       s.benchmark_at AS "evaluated at", s.score_version AS version
  FROM subject s CROSS JOIN benchmark b LEFT JOIN cohort c ON true
 ORDER BY c.asking_rate, c.article_id

panels.title: Asking-price trend — ${deal} — market context before price filters
panels.description: Historical daily P25, median and P75 asking rates. Sale is KM/m²; rent is KM/m²/month. Price/score/view/review filters do not rewrite this historical context; provisional, inferred and stale flags stay visible.

targets.rawSql:
WITH validation AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_price:sqlstring}, ${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price for selected deal') AS min_price_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_rate:sqlstring}, ${max_rate:sqlstring}, 'asking rate for selected deal') AS min_rate_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_area:sqlstring}, ${max_area:sqlstring}, 'area') AS min_area_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_score:sqlstring}, ${max_score:sqlstring}, 'score', 100) AS min_score_ok
)
SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       CASE WHEN d.neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR d.neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE d.neighborhood END AS neighbourhood,
       
       CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE rate_eligible) >= 10
            THEN percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) FILTER (WHERE rate_eligible) END AS "p25 asking rate",
       CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE rate_eligible) >= 10
            THEN percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) FILTER (WHERE rate_eligible) END AS "median asking rate",
       CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE rate_eligible) >= 10
            THEN percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) FILTER (WHERE rate_eligible) END AS "p75 asking rate",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE rate_eligible)::int AS "rate sample",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE membership_inferred OR attributes_inferred)::int AS inferred,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE stale_observation)::int AS stale,
       bool_or(provisional_day) AS provisional
  FROM reporting.daily_listing_facts d CROSS JOIN validation
 WHERE d.day >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date
                    - reporting.numeric_bound(${analysis_days:sqlstring}, 'analysis window', 90)::int
    AND d.day <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date
    AND d.deal = ${deal:sqlstring}
    AND COALESCE(d.property_type, 'unknown') = ${property_type:sqlstring}
    AND ((ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__mapped__'] AND CASE WHEN d.neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR d.neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE d.neighborhood END <> 'unknown')
         OR CASE WHEN d.neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR d.neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE d.neighborhood END = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
         OR COALESCE(d.room_bucket, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]))
    AND reporting.within_bounds(d.sqm, ${min_area:sqlstring}, ${max_area:sqlstring}, 'area')
    AND (ARRAY[${condition:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR COALESCE(d.historical_condition, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${condition:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${furnishing:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR COALESCE(d.historical_furnished::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${furnishing:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${parking:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR COALESCE(COALESCE(d.historical_attributes->>'parking', d.historical_attributes->'searchAttributes'->>'parking'), 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${parking:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${seller_type:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR COALESCE(d.historical_seller_type, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${seller_type:sqlstring}]))
 GROUP BY day, CASE WHEN d.neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR d.neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE d.neighborhood END
 ORDER BY day, neighbourhood

         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_score:sqlstring}, ${max_score:sqlstring}, 'score', 100) AS min_score_ok
)
SELECT m.event_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       CASE WHEN m.neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR m.neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE m.neighborhood END AS neighbourhood,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.movement_type = 'first_observation')::int AS "first observations",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.movement_type = 'reopening')::int AS reopenings,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.movement_type = 'closure')::int AS "observed closures",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.membership_inferred OR m.attributes_inferred)::int AS inferred
  FROM reporting.lifecycle_movements m CROSS JOIN validation
 WHERE m.event_day >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date
                     - reporting.numeric_bound(${analysis_days:sqlstring}, 'analysis window', 90)::int
   AND m.deal = ${deal:sqlstring}
    AND COALESCE(m.property_type, 'unknown') = ${property_type:sqlstring}
    AND ((ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__mapped__'] AND CASE WHEN m.neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR m.neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE m.neighborhood END <> 'unknown')
         OR CASE WHEN m.neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR m.neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE m.neighborhood END = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
         OR COALESCE(m.room_bucket, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]))
    AND reporting.within_bounds(m.sqm, ${min_area:sqlstring}, ${max_area:sqlstring}, 'area')
   AND m.event_at <= now()
   AND (ARRAY[${condition:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR COALESCE(m.historical_attributes->>'condition', m.historical_attributes->'searchAttributes'->>'condition', 'unknown')
         = ANY (ARRAY[${condition:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${furnishing:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR COALESCE(m.historical_attributes->>'furnished', m.historical_attributes->'searchAttributes'->>'furnished', 'unknown')
         = ANY (ARRAY[${furnishing:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${parking:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR COALESCE(m.historical_attributes->>'parking', m.historical_attributes->'searchAttributes'->>'parking', 'unknown')
         = ANY (ARRAY[${parking:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${seller_type:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR COALESCE(m.historical_attributes->>'sellerType', m.historical_attributes->'searchAttributes'->>'sellerType', 'unknown')
         = ANY (ARRAY[${seller_type:sqlstring}]))
 GROUP BY m.event_day, CASE WHEN m.neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR m.neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE m.neighborhood END
 ORDER BY m.event_day, neighbourhood

panels.title: Observed exits
panels.description: Closed observation cycles in the selected analysis window, with separate duration and eligible final asking-price samples. Final observed asking price is not a transaction price.

targets.rawSql:
WITH validation AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_price:sqlstring}, ${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price for selected deal') AS min_price_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_rate:sqlstring}, ${max_rate:sqlstring}, 'asking rate for selected deal') AS min_rate_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_area:sqlstring}, ${max_area:sqlstring}, 'area') AS min_area_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_score:sqlstring}, ${max_score:sqlstring}, 'score', 100) AS min_score_ok
)
SELECT CASE WHEN c.closing_neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR c.closing_neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE c.closing_neighborhood END AS neighbourhood,
       count(*)::int AS "observed closure cycles",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.observed_cycle_duration_days)
         FILTER (WHERE c.observed_cycle_duration_days IS NOT NULL) AS "median observed cycle days",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.observed_cycle_duration_days IS NOT NULL)::int AS "duration sample",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.final_asking_price)
         FILTER (WHERE c.closing_price_eligible) AS "median final asking price",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.closing_price_eligible)::int AS "final-price sample",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.closing_membership_inferred OR c.closing_attributes_inferred)::int AS inferred
  FROM reporting.lifecycle_cycles c CROSS JOIN validation
 WHERE c.closed_day >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date
                      - reporting.numeric_bound(${analysis_days:sqlstring}, 'analysis window', 90)::int
   AND c.is_closed
   AND c.closed_at <= now()
   AND c.closing_deal = ${deal:sqlstring}
    AND COALESCE(c.closing_property_type, 'unknown') = ${property_type:sqlstring}
    AND ((ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__mapped__'] AND CASE WHEN c.closing_neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR c.closing_neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE c.closing_neighborhood END <> 'unknown')
         OR CASE WHEN c.closing_neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR c.closing_neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE c.closing_neighborhood END = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
         OR COALESCE(c.closing_room_bucket, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]))
    AND reporting.within_bounds(c.closing_sqm, ${min_area:sqlstring}, ${max_area:sqlstring}, 'area')
 GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.closing_neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR c.closing_neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE c.closing_neighborhood END
 ORDER BY "observed closure cycles" DESC, neighbourhood
